scope: Five finance batch creation families: immutable original command receipt, recovery and unwritten cancellation
ownership: Batch Service/Controller, V1054 and tests; FinancialJsonResults shared reader. Other document approval wrappers and shared operation journal are owned by separate agents.
preserved: FINANCE-BATCH:{actor}:{key} advisory transaction lock with seed991
SHA256 UTF8 of type + colon + recursive key-sorted documents, original arrays/scalars and pre-grouping order
old successful result/hash/actor/key/time bytes, original grouping and child accounting authority
one transaction for every child document and successful receipt
no Win7/WPF implementation, deployment or publishing

protocol.absence: found:false is unknown, never unwritten proof
protocol.legacy: GET identifies requestBodyAvailable:false; cancel/resolve verifies original body against the unchanged old hash and returns original success without backfilling stored body
protocol.lateCreate: 409 with found/key/actor/outcome details, never an empty successful batch; clients still corroborate the original receipt
protocol.permissions: Own actor and family view required; lost create but retained read may resolve/cancel. Lost read denied. Visitor, must-change-password, locked and impersonated identities cannot cancel.
protocol.rejectedInput: Current create admission limits are not rerun when sealing the original body; 501-row rejected attempts remain recoverable without truncation

precision.scope: Immutable ObjectReader keeps configured modules and integer policy; both decimal float features enabled and trailing-zero stripping disabled

beforeSharedReader.boundary: Before final shared reader/maxDocuments adoption, do not substitute for final reader-caller verification

finalResult.boundary: Actual PostgreSQL protocol/transaction/immutability and grouping passthrough verified. Child domain services are controlled work oracles; this is not a substitute for real ERP accounting/application UAT.

retainedFailures: Initial PG found default JSON readTree round-trip through double changed finite 40+24/Instant values. Success replay, receipt and cancellation now use the single exact financial result reader. Original failure log retained.
